schedule: Rounds 1–200 reproduce the original cosine schedule; rounds 201–1000 use fixed LR 0.001.
scope: Ideal aggregation, FL only, no FU, no radio or mission timing; not Proposed or a method comparison.
controls: Same features, captions, splits, gallery, partitions, initial vector and per-round batch generator. The first 200 rounds must reproduce the existing independent FL-only pilot.
interpretation: Tests additional learning with a restarted nonzero learning rate, not the causal effect of round count alone. All checkpoints and both dataset outcomes are retained. No best-checkpoint selection.
